blocks.text: The comparison group is finished and ready for your approval, and the survey purchases can be raised against it the day it is signed off. It runs to twenty-two companies, built on the revenue band we agreed, the sectors {{fact:f:E-2023-001.client}} actually hires from, and privately held ownership only, and every company on the list carries a one-line reason for being there. I am sending the list itself this afternoon.

There are two things I need from your side before collection starts. The first is the approval in writing, because the group fixes what every figure in the final report is measured against and we do not want to be moving it later. The second is a contact in your finance or personnel team who can confirm the current package structure for four of the positions, where the job description and the pay schedule do not agree with each other.

Otherwise the position schedule closed last week at eleven positions, both surveys are specified and priced, and I have started pulling the aggregate compensation detail from our own search files in the same revenue band. Nothing in that material identifies a company or a person, and nothing in the report will name an employee of yours.
If the approval reaches me by the end of the month, the first cut of the data will be with you before the end of May.
